segments.title: September
segments.text: Hello Pop-up! September is The Comeback, plus fifty-seven days to Diwali. Routines are back, festive photos are coming, and everyone suddenly remembers they wanted to feel great in October. We're here to help, with a deadline.

segments.title: ₹2.73L
segments.text: So, the number. Our September target for Pop-up is 2.73 lakh rupees. That's 44 per cent more than last September. Ambitious, yes. Unreasonable, no.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? New clients lead the way with 1.26 lakh rupees. That's 5 of every 10 rupees. Then renewals 1.2 lakh, comebacks 23,600, and everything else 2,700. New clients carry this month, so every trial is a first impression worth getting right.

segments.title: 72 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 842 leads, 219 trials, and 72 buyers, with about 33 per cent of trials converting. Every five trials should become about one member. Make those first classes unforgettable.
Here's where the offers come in. Three offers carry 1.39 lakh rupees, which is 51 per cent of our target. The rest is full-price. Offers open the door. Great classes keep it open. Let's meet them.

segments.title: The Second Date's On Us
segments.text: First up, for newcomers, The Second Date's On Us. First class at half price, the second one free, and the third? That's a relationship, with fifteen per cent off the first month and an extra freeze. The plan is 11 buyers at about 5,900, so 64,800 rupees.

segments.title: New Phone, Who Dis?
segments.text: Next, for everyone else who drifted, New Phone, Who Dis? One free, no-questions-asked comeback class. Buy within seven days, and get fifteen per cent off plus an extra freeze. The plan is 4 buyers at about 5,900, so 23,600 rupees.

segments.title: Same Time Next Week
segments.text: And finally, for pack regulars, Same Time Next Week. Nearly out of classes? Take the same pack again at fifteen per cent off, plus an extra week of validity so nothing goes to waste. The plan is 7 buyers at about 7,200, so 50,600 rupees.
segments.notes: Pop-up clients whose class pack is running out.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, every offer goes live and the team knows them by heart. Week two, check sell-through every Monday and follow up every trial within a day. Week three, the seven-day comeback window opens for everyone else. Week four, close the month, tag every redemption, and brief next month.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's September at Pop-up. 2.73 lakh rupees, three offers, and 72 buyers to welcome. Fifty-seven days. No pressure. Well, a little pressure.
